semantics.basis: Fixed v3 observed shape and official v1/v2 examples; no explicit reviewed v3 contract.
semantics.chinese_segmentation: Statistical system stated by official info; implementation/model/version/parameters unknown.
semantics.v3_cutoff_reason: FAQ 40 books and v1/v2 >40 occurrences are not treated as the same v3 rule.
semantics.duplicate_totals_policy: First record per year used for diagnostics; duplicates remain anomalies.

attribution.modifications: Read-only structural diagnostics, field sums and limited record hashes; no source edits or approved frequency values.
attribution.scope: Compilation only; not original book text rights. Explicit fixture hashes do not establish corpus authenticity.

limits: Global duplicate detection stores token strings, O(unique tokens) memory; year aggregation O(years).
UTF8 token byte sum is payload size, not allocated/live/peak process memory.
Field sums include aliases/tag forms; field3 sums do not deduplicate books across words or years.
Missing token-year pairs are structural and only computed for a complete anomaly-free scan; never observed zero.
Limited examples retain line/record SHA; full anomaly counters include later records and source originals remain available.
